blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — A municipal councilor of Oas, Albay, was arrested following a hit-and-run incident in neighboring Libon town on Saturday afternoon that resulted in the death of a 13-year-old cyclist and injuries to three other persons, according to the police. The unnamed suspect was driving a car when it allegedly struck a motorcycle and two cyclists along the National Road in Barangay Rawis at 4:20 p.m. on Oct. 24, the Libon Municipal Police Station said in a press statement.
